description: Statistics Portugal publishes the main census data of 1991, 2001, 2011 and 2021 with the Base Geográfica de Referenciação de Informação (BGRI), the geographic frame that divides each parish into statistical sections and subsections, which are city blocks in urban areas and places or parts of places in rural areas. The 2021 summary file by subsection has 32 variables: classic buildings, buildings built for one or two or for three or more dwellings, exclusively residential buildings, buildings with one or two or three or more floors, five periods of construction from before 1945 to 2011-2021, buildings needing repair, dwellings by use (usual residence, vacant or secondary), dwellings accessible by wheelchair or with parking, owner-occupied and rented dwellings, households, family nuclei and residents by sex and age. The same page offers the subsection and section geometries by area, a 1 km grid and places. Format and access: ZIP downloads of summary tables and geographic layers, free and without registration, with a QGIS plugin. Licence: the BGRI metadata gives public access without restrictions and use without conditions; free. Caveats: variables are counts only, with no heating, water or energy detail at subsection level, and the files use Latin-1 text. Simulation uses: block-level building age, height and repair needs for seismic and flood exposure, and dwelling counts for demand. Related records: the INE Spain census section indicators and the GHSL built-up and population grids.
